# Running the tests

It needs Node 20 or newer. Once, in this folder: `npm ci` (exactly the packages package-lock.json holds), then `npx cypress install` (the Cypress app: minutes).

| To | Type |
| --- | --- |
| the quick check: every kind of page opens | `npm run smoke` |
| every test | `npm test` |
| one family (smoke, critical, navigation, links, stories, api, or one of yours) | `npm run family -- critical` |
| watch it in a browser | `npm run open` |
| in another browser | `npm test -- --browser firefox` |
| against another copy of the site (staging) | `BASE_URL=https://staging.example.com npm test` |

`README.md` lists every way to run it. `crew` offers the usual ones, and the test library: every family and test
on one page in your browser, run with a click (`node menu/library.mjs`).

## What a run says

Each test prints its steps in plain words as it takes them (`3. Click "Careers" in the header`). At the end:
how many passed of each kind, the slowest pages, any page much slower than in the run before, and the tests a
known bug blocked. The whole run is in `cypress/report.html`.

## Every run is timed

Each page's time is kept (`cypress/timings/timings.csv`). A page much slower than in the run before is named; many pages slower by
about the same time is said once, as one cause: the way to the site, not each page.
